name: Nashik
desc: In Nashik, where fast-paced urban life meets complex financial planning, Hari Kotian brings 25+ years of IRDAI-certified expertise. Get personalized doorstep consultations for life, health, and motor insurance tailored to your family's exact requirements.
it_focus: Group Health insurance and personal accident covers for manufacturing employees at Ambad MIDC and IT zone.
senior_focus: Comprehensive senior citizen health cover and pension assistance for residents of Panchvati and Gangapur Road.
branch_dets: Coordination with LIC offices at Main Road Nashik and major insurer branches at College Road and Gangapur Road.

local_faqs.question: Which hospitals offer cashless treatment in Nashik?
local_faqs.answer: Sankalp Hospital, Vignaharta Multi-Speciality Hospital, Lokmanya Hospital, and Apollo Hospital Nashik are in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Do you advise farmers in the Nashik grape belt on insurance?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we structure crop insurance, livestock, tractor, and hospital covers for families around Sinner and Pimpalgaon Baswant.
